_doc: The restart window's settings: copy to $KREW_HOME/restart-window.json. OFF until enabled is true. Every list is empty by default, so an enabled window with no tiers restarts nothing and says so in `facts`. tiers: unit -> tier (lower restarts first; the front door restarts last). crew_units / front_door_units / api_units / hermes_units: which units are the crew, the front door (crissa rules on the card), the API and Hermes. rulers: who may answer the card; owner_authors: whose card comments count as the owner's reboot reason; hands_words: extra words that mean 'needs hands'. busy: ear_health_url, ear_unit, hands_procs, speak_procs (a restart waits while any is busy; empty = not checked). api: health_detailed_url and key_env (the env var holding its key). occupancy: mode_file / pending_file (a GPU occupancy switch, if you run one). unit_ports, port_wait_s, health_path, wall_units, self_unit: the post-checks. post_reboot_checks: name -> health URL, checked four minutes after a reboot. nightly_unit: the restart waits while it runs. hermes_tree_script: the Hermes patch-stack check run before restarting hermes_units (unset = krew's own crew/scripts/hermes-tree.py; a path that does not exist = 'not checked'). hermes_patch_queue: the patches it checks (unset = krew's patches/); the Hermes tree is KREW_HERMES_TREE or HERMES_TREE, else ~/.hermes/hermes-agent. list_root: where the window's card lists live. `_reference_install` is the machine krew was built on, verbatim except the owner's own name (left out of rulers, owner_authors and hands_words), an agent name and two dev-box ports (placeholders in <>), its `house` name prefix written `ref` (ref-<name>.service); nothing reads it.

_reference_install.hermes_tree_script: scripts/hermes-tree.py (krew ships it as crew/scripts/hermes-tree.py: the default)
